purpose: Readiness inventory, not an executable queue or device authorization. Object order is not scheduling order; docs/ROADMAP.md alone owns priority. Exact inputs, budgets and chronology stay in linked experiments.
selection_note: The exact passive CONSYS candidate is selected for one guarded boot2 installation and later owner physical boot selection. Installation must bind predecessor 22edf533...16e8 or skip an already matching full partition, verify full readback, and shut down without reboot. The one physical boot and collection budgets remain unconsumed.

keyboard-coverage.readiness_note: Size and full-duration lifecycle evidence accepted. Transport-disconnect evidence, prerequisite validation and fresh device admission remain incomplete. Production capture stays disabled; the accepted package is not a boot or input-test candidate.

dependencies.required_result: Exact frozen baseline passes serviceability with reviewed recovery and the read-only protocol has exact device identity and finite budgets. Keyboard coverage is independent.

emmc-readonly.readiness_note: Single read and log budgets consumed. Independent changed-ID Gemian confirmation passed; native request transport remains inconclusive and the aggregate remains incomplete. Exact results and pause closure are in the readiness record. No retry or dependent test selected.

wifi-parent-attribution.readiness_note: Completed Gemian metadata observations; budgets consumed and custody released. No new boot2 candidate. Corrected helpers are not admitted for another attempt.

wifi-live-nvram-identity.readiness_note: Offline packet passed independent review. Its first one-SSH invocation refused before the admission barrier, so no selected data was read and the observation budget remains unconsumed. Do not retry automatically; re-establish live OS/transport and review a fresh admission if boot identity changed. No boot2 candidate or partition write.

dependencies.required_result: Reuse the authenticated USB serviceability and changed-ID Gemian recovery foundation; the prior TOPRGU restart action is not repeated.

mt6797-consys-passive-boot.readiness_note: Buildbox package, exact passive candidate/input, zero-effect collector, recovery identities and guarded deployment packet passed independent review. One standing-authorized boot2 installation is admitted under the exact live guards, followed by clean shutdown. The owner alone physically selects boot2; no automatic reboot and no hardware-support claim.

dependencies.required_result: Authenticated USB serviceability, complete log preservation and changed-ID Gemian recovery are accepted preparation inputs.

mt6797-toprgu-minimal-restart.readiness_note: The candidate was selected once. Authenticated serviceability and logging passed, but live ramoops reported zero address and size, so no restart request was issued and the attempt is inconclusive. The owner physically recovered the device; one bounded authenticated check confirmed changed-ID Gemian 3.18.41+ on AArch64. The artifact is consumed and must not be retried; diagnose its DT/ramoops composition offline.
